cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The collapsed cake was foreshadowed by that first wobble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I allowed the audience to discover its significance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The empty stand pays off the warning beautifully.
